title: seat.joined payload, schemaVersion 1
description: A seat joins its table at Shuffle Up, carrying how this player's stuff should look: their deck's name for the name label, their playmat, and their sleeve. Sent before any card so the table can draw the whole player area first. Sleeves are optional; when sleeveColor is present it wins over cardBackImageUrl, and an unsleeved seat keeps the standard Magic card back.

seatId.description: A short GUID identifying this seat. Seat identity is distinct from the player's display name.

playerName.description: Display only. Not unique, not an identity.

deckName.description: The deck's display name, player-chosen content — verbatim, no truncation. Shown with the player name on the seat's name label.

playmatImageUrl.description: Absolute URL of this seat's playmat art; opaque to the receiver.

cardBackImageUrl.description: Absolute URL of the card-back image. Omitted when a sleeve is defined; sleeveColor wins if both arrive.

sleeveColor.description: The seat's sleeve as a solid color (hex). Player identity data — commander-damage counters need the raw hex. A game constant: chosen before the game, never changed mid-game.
